name: data.table
resume: 54 exports are checked against data.table 1.18.6.1. The rest is left unfinished. A data frame is Polars, and that is not a check. The collapsed open notes were reference updates, the [ syntax, S4 classes, fread and fwrite, and the froll kernel.

functions.name: %between%
functions.done: Length-2 bounds passed to between with closed ends.

functions.name: %chin%
functions.done: Character membership. A miss is FALSE, including a missing string that is not in the table.

check.case: a and b against b and c.

functions.name: %flike%
functions.done: like with fixed TRUE.

check.case: A fixed dot, not a regular-expression dot.

functions.name: %ilike%
functions.done: like with ignore.case TRUE.

functions.name: %like%
functions.done: like with the default case-sensitive pattern.

functions.name: %notin%
functions.done: Membership with NA equal to NA. A miss is TRUE.

check.case: 1 and NA against 1. NA matches NA, and a miss is TRUE.

functions.name: %plike%
functions.done: like with perl TRUE.

functions.name: as.IDate
functions.done: Integer days since the epoch. A character date is parsed, and a number counts from origin.

functions.name: as.ITime
functions.done: Seconds since midnight, wrapped into one day.

functions.name: between
functions.done: Integer, double, and character between, ported from src/between.c.

functions.name: chmatch
functions.done: First character match. NA matches NA.

check.case: b, a, and z against a, b, a. The miss is NA.

functions.name: CJ
functions.done: Cross join. sorted orders each input, and the last vector varies fastest.

check.case: Sorted cross join of b,a with 2:1. The last column varies fastest.

functions.name: copy
functions.done: Duplicate a vector or a plain list.

functions.name: fcoalesce
functions.done: First non-missing value. Types must already match, and a kept NaN stays NaN when nan=NaN.

check.case: First non-missing of two length-3 vectors.

functions.name: fifelse
functions.done: Vector if/else. test is logical, and yes, no, and na share a length and a type.

check.case: TRUE, FALSE, and NA choose from 1:3 and 4:6.

functions.name: first
functions.done: First element, or head when n is supplied. An xts object stops because xts is not installed.

functions.name: frev
functions.done: Reverse an atomic vector, or the order of a plain list.

functions.name: frollmax
functions.done: Exact rolling maximum.

check.case: Right-aligned max of five values, window 3.

functions.name: frollmean
functions.done: Exact rolling mean. A complete window with no missing values divides by the window width.

functions.name: frollmedian
functions.done: Exact rolling median. An even count averages the two central values.

check.case: Right-aligned median, window 3. An even window averages the two central values.

functions.name: frollmin
functions.done: Exact rolling minimum.

check.case: Right-aligned min of five values, window 3.

functions.name: frollprod
functions.done: Exact rolling product.

functions.name: frollsd
functions.done: Square root of the rolling sample variance.

check.case: Sample standard deviation of 1:6 with window 3.

functions.name: frollsum
functions.done: Exact rolling sum. Left and center shift that right-aligned window, as src/froll.c does.

functions.name: frollvar
functions.done: Exact rolling sample variance, divided by k - 1 and clamped at 0.

functions.name: getNumericRounding
functions.done: Read the numeric rounding level used by the radix sort. The default is 0.

functions.name: hour
functions.done: Hour from seconds since midnight.

functions.name: IDateTime
functions.done: Two columns, idate and itime, from one date-time string.

functions.name: isoweek
functions.done: ISO week, the same numbering as %V.

functions.name: isoyear
functions.done: ISO year, the same numbering as %G.

functions.name: last
functions.done: Last element, or tail when n is supplied. An xts object stops because xts is not installed.

functions.name: like
functions.done: grepl, including a factor matched on its levels.

check.case: grepl of ab on abc, ABC, and xyz.

functions.name: mday
functions.done: Day of the month, including 29 February.

functions.name: minute
functions.done: Minute from seconds since midnight.

functions.name: month
functions.done: Month number from src/idatetime.c.

functions.name: nafill
functions.done: Constant, locf, and nocb fills. The default treats NaN as missing.

functions.name: quarter
functions.done: Quarter number from src/idatetime.c.

functions.name: rleid
functions.done: Run-length ids. Consecutive NA values stay in one run.

check.case: Runs in a, a, b, b, a.

functions.name: rleidv
functions.done: Run-length ids across columns.

check.case: Two columns, a change in either one starts a run.

functions.name: rowid
functions.done: How many times each value has been seen, counting the current row.

check.case: Occurrence numbers of a, b, a, a, b.

functions.name: rowidv
functions.done: rowid across columns. A repeated key increases the id.

check.case: Occurrence numbers of two columns together.

functions.name: second
functions.done: Second from seconds since midnight.

functions.name: setnames
functions.done: Replace column names by reference on the data.table object.

functions.name: setNumericRounding
functions.done: Store a rounding level of 0, 1, or 2.

check.case: Set the level to 2 and read it back, then restore 0.

functions.name: shift
functions.done: Lag, lead, shift, and cyclic shift of an atomic vector. A matrix stops with data.table's message.

check.case: Lag 1 and lead 1 of 1:5, filled with 0.

functions.name: transpose
functions.done: Rows become columns. A short column is filled, and the common type is the wider one.

check.case: list(1:3, 4:5) fills the short column with NA.

functions.name: tstrsplit
functions.done: strsplit, then transpose. The split is a regular expression.

check.case: Split on a comma and transpose.

functions.name: uniqueN
functions.done: Count of distinct values. NA is one value unless na.rm is TRUE.

functions.name: wday
functions.done: Weekday with Sunday as 1. 1970-01-01 is Thursday.

functions.name: week
functions.done: Legacy week number, yday %/% 7 + 1.

functions.name: yday
functions.done: Day of the year. 2020-02-29 is 60.

functions.name: year
functions.done: Calendar year from src/idatetime.c.

functions.name: yearmon
functions.done: A double, year + (month - 1) / 12. This is not zoo's yearmon.

check.case: Year plus a fraction of the month.

functions.name: yearqtr
functions.done: A double, year + (quarter - 1) / 4. This is not zoo's yearqtr.

check.case: Year plus a fraction of the quarter.
